screen.title: ICD code lists
screen.purpose: The classifications the hospital codes in: the bundled WHO ICD-11 and, under the hospital's own WHO licence, ICD-10; which one doctors code in.

rule_objects.text: List the releases with source, codes, licence note and the active flag per classification.

'Load code list': multipart upload (file + code_system + release_label + licence_note, which ICD-10 requires: WHO licenses ICD-10 separately and it is never shipped). ICD_IMPORT_INVALID lists examples of what is wrong; ICD_RELEASE_EXISTS: that release is already loaded.

Switching the classification doctors code in is the setting icd_coding_system (the Super Admin's settings: PUT /admin/settings/icd_coding_system), refused until a list of that classification is active.

definition_of_done.rule: Agents MUST submit propose_progress after implementing this screen and verify it with progress_proposals. Only the developer accepts items on My progress for what this implementation does on the DEV server. No tool awards progress.

endpoints.summary: Load an ICD code list (the hospital's licensed ICD-10, or a newer WHO ICD-11 release)

write.on_lost_answer: A repeat is refused with ICD_RELEASE_EXISTS: the release is loaded already. The first call may have succeeded; this error does not replay its result. Never retry automatically; re-read the record, then offer the action again only if it is still needed.

endpoints.summary: Make a release the active list of its classification

write.on_lost_answer: A repeat is harmless for the same state: the release is active already. No response is stored; re-read before resubmitting because newer data may have arrived.

realtime.rule: Refresh the listed reads when the event arrives (a list without a path id: every time; a detail read: when the payload names the same id). Never poll.
